imageNote: Pie chart and treemap screenshots are real, unaltered captures from Tableau's own official help site (help.tableau.com), pulled from the 'Build a Pie Chart' and 'Build a Treemap' pages. Tableau has NO built-in donut chart type and no dedicated official documentation page for one — a targeted search confirmed only third-party tutorial sites (DataCamp, InterWorks, DataFlair, etc.) cover it, and this course's image policy does not permit sourcing screenshots from those sites for a GUI-specific lesson. Per the pilot lesson's precedent, the donut construction technique is instead shown as an original LTV-authored steps diagram (not a screenshot, not claimed as one) describing the standard workaround: layer a second pie on the same axis and shrink it into a white center circle.
